title: aisstream.io AIS
description: Worldwide AIS from aisstream.io over one connection subscribed to the whole world. The API key comes from secretRefs.apiKey (e.g. env:AISSTREAM_API_KEY) and never appears here. Vessels over the map clients' viewports and on the watchlist are stored at full rate; every other vessel at the background interval, updating its entity but not track history.

watchlistMmsi.title: Watchlist (MMSI)
watchlistMmsi.description: Vessels always stored at full rate, wherever they are; nine-digit MMSIs

movingIntervalSec.title: Moving vessel interval (s)
movingIntervalSec.description: At most one stored position per watched moving vessel this often; 0 stores every report

stationaryIntervalSec.title: Stationary vessel interval (s)
stationaryIntervalSec.description: The same for watched vessels moored, at anchor, aground or slower than the stationary speed

backgroundIntervalSec.title: Background interval (s)
backgroundIntervalSec.description: At most one position this often for vessels outside every viewport and off the watchlist
